title: Cold outreach target row
description: One row = one person at one company, validated before it is eligible for any Instantly upload. Filling this schema does not authorize a send -- see INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_SETUP_CHECKLIST.md.

first_name.description: Used in {{first_name}} merge field. Must match how the person signs their own public work, not a guessed casual form.

title.description: Current public title, e.g. from LinkedIn or company site. Not used as a merge field directly, but drives segment routing.

company.description: Used in {{company}} merge field. Should match the company name as the prospect writes it publicly.

email_confidence.description: 0-1. Below 0.7, row is not upload-eligible until re-validated (see bounce_status).

linkedin_url.description: Optional. Used for manual QA of the personalization_hook, not sent to Instantly.

personalization_hook.description: One sentence, tied to a SPECIFIC piece of the prospect's public work (a launch, a talk, a repo, a blog post). Used in {{personalization_hook}} merge field. Must never be fabricated -- if no real hook exists, leave the row out of the send batch rather than inventing one.

source.description: Where this row came from. prospect_dossiers_20260703 refers to work/hfo_prey_workflow/scout_agent_release_gate_prospects_20260703/prospect_dossiers.json, the 24-company list this campaign's schema was built against.

validated_at_utc.description: When email was last run through a verification pass (syntax + MX + deliverability check). Empty means unvalidated -- not upload-eligible.

bounce_status.description: unknown = never checked. Only 'valid' rows should reach an active Instantly campaign; 'risky' needs operator judgment call; 'invalid' rows are dropped, not sent.
